paragraphs.text: The visionary Kadesha , whose personal name is not known (Kadesha is a title), was leader of the town of Hamath on Corondor ( Dominaria ). The House of the Kadesha was the throne of Pearl Magic.

The Kadesha summoned a Thunder Spirit on the Plains of Urlan to stop Jared Carthalion , whom she believed to be a minion of Ravidel . She allowed Kristina of the Woods to take Jared from Hamath instead of punishing him.
